consequences: Lint output is clean, so a new warning stands out. A real specificity bug must be caught by the Playwright and axe tests, not by lint.
context: It gave 13 warnings in packages/ui/src/styles.css, each between two unrelated components. Nothing rendered wrong. Rejected: reordering the stylesheet to satisfy it, which risks changing which rule wins for no user benefit.
decision: The rule style/noDescendingSpecificity is turned off for **/*.css in biome.json. All other rules stay on.
title: Biome's noDescendingSpecificity is off for CSS
